newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Anscor declares 25 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Anscor declares 25 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Holding company A. Soriano Corp (Anscor) said on Thursday that its board has declared a 25 percent stock dividend.
The proposed payout will be submitted for approval to stockholders on April 16, 1997, the company said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
No record and payment date had yet been set for the stock dividend.
The company did not declare any stock dividends in 1996 but granted a 25 percent stock dividend in 1995. The company's financial years end in December.
Anscor has core investments in port management, wire and cable manufacturing and financial services.
